column1: # STEPS.tsv -- THE DESIGN-PLAN prolog-gnu-gaps STEP TABLE (the cto, 2026-11-07, CTO-543; skill prolog reference section 8). The seven prolog-iso-family-* rows of 2026-09-02 are superseded by it: a live probe of their 97 names found 88 already answered by SCRIP (the GNU prelude landed in October); these are the gaps that remain, one witness each (current_mirror/2 was probed too and already answers as gprolog under the GNU dialect).

# harness/scripts/test_design_prolog_gnu_gaps_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N runs the step witnesses (this folder, gg_*.pl beside .ref cut from GNU Prolog 1.6.0 through gprolog_bin(), twice, filtered by gprolog_output_filter) in mode 3 and mode 4 under --dialect=gnu from a scratch folder, this folder's path written DIR; --cut re-cuts the refs.
# probe: witnesses (every witness of the step byte-equal to its .ref with rc 0 in mode 3 and mode 4). depends: the steps a step waits on (none: every step stands alone).

column7: CTO-543: countall/2 (BipsPl/call.pl) in every dialect: N checked first (type_error(integer), domain_error(not_less_than_zero)), the goal checked as call/1 does with countall/2 as context, the count of its solutions

CTO-543: current_evaluable/1 (BipsPl/arith_inl.pl) in every dialect: the indicator checked as gprolog's Pl_Get_Pred_Indicator (type_error(predicate_indicator), type_error(atom), type_error(integer), domain_error(not_less_than_zero)); enumerates the '$ev'/2 table of the embedded prelude
CTO-543: inc/1 and dec/1 are evaluable functors (gprolog 1.6.0, number -> number), evaluated beside msb/1 in src/runtime/arithmetic.c and admitted in the lowerer's unary list and the '$ev'/2 table

CTO-543: evaluable_property(E, iso) holds for the ISO 13211-1 evaluables as gprolog marks them (the gg_evaluable_property_iso.ref list); a third '$ev_is'/3 clause reads an '$ev_iso'/1 fact table beside '$ev'/2

CTO-543: set_stream_alias/2 (BipsPl/stream.pl, Pl_Set_Alias_To_Stream with override) in every dialect: an alias held by another stream moves to this one, no permission_error; the stream checked as add_stream_alias/2 checks its own

CTO-543: term_hash/4 hashes to the depth as gprolog's Term_Hash_Rec (depth consumed by a list cell or a compound, never by an atomic; at 0 a compound hashes its functor and arity only, a list cell '.'/2; -1 unbounded), then H mod Range
CTO-543: listing/0 in the GNU dialect lists every user predicate through '$gnu_listing'/1 with an unbound indicator, per file in order, as listing/1 does for one

CTO-543: the C stream leaves character_count/2, line_count/2, line_position/2, stream_line_column/3 and set_stream_position/2 raise with their own indicator as the error context (pl_gnu_ctx after the stream resolves), as gprolog does

CTO-543: the prelude helpers '$gnu_b_rd'/4 and '$gnu_b_key'/4 resolve their stream through '$gnu_b_sora'/3 with the caller's indicator before set_input/1, so get_key/2, get_key_no_echo/2, read_token/2, read_atom/2, read_integer/2 and read_number/2 raise as gprolog does
